chunks: And what will make you comprehend what the Day of Judgement is?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Yawm al-Din' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question highlights the transcendence of Yawm al-Din beyond human cognitive limits, underscoring the necessity of divine revelation to comprehend its realities. It serves as a profound reminder of the ultimate accountability (Hisab) where every soul will be held responsible for its deeds, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (Adl) central to Shia theology.
